info.title: Adona market data
info.description:
Candle history and live market data for data customers.

**Two secrets, both on `Authorization: Bearer`.** A long-lived API key (`adk_live_…`) is exchanged at `POST /v1/tokens` for a twelve-hour access token; every other call carries that token. Sending one where the other belongs is answered by name, not by an opaque 401. The key belongs on your server: `POST /v1/tokens` refuses a browser's preflight.

**Every refusal from the routes below carries a code: `{"detail": "CODE"}`**, and a 422 adds the reason: `{"detail": "CODE: text"}`. Branch on the part before the first colon. A 422 also lists the offending fields as data, `"fields": [{"loc": ["limit"], "reason": "…"}]` (empty when no field can be named, such as a body that is not JSON), so a client can point at the field without parsing the text. Each route lists its codes below with what to do.

**Live stream.** `POST /v1/ws-ticket` returns a single-use ticket. Open `wss://<host>/v1/stream` offering TWO subprotocols: `adona.data.v1` and `ticket.<ticket>`, e.g. `new WebSocket(url, ["adona.data.v1", "ticket." + ticket])`. The ticket never goes in the URL: a ticket sent only in the query string is ignored, and the connection is refused with no reason. Five frames are accepted: `ping`, `subscribe`, `unsubscribe`, `candle.watch`, `candle.unwatch`; anything else answers `FRAME_NOT_ALLOWED`. Channels are `quote:<SYMBOL>` and `candle:<SYMBOL>:<TIMEFRAME>`.

**Close codes.** 1008 carries a reason you must not reconnect in a loop on: `CUSTOMER_ACCESS_REVOKED`, `CUSTOMER_TRIAL_EXPIRED`, `CUSTOMER_CONNECTION_LIMIT`, `EXPECTED_DATA_TOKEN`, `INVALID_TICKET` (mint a new ticket once), and `RATE_LIMITED` (more than 40 messages a second: slow down, then reconnect). 1009 `FRAME_TOO_LARGE`: a message over 16 KiB; split the subscription. 1011 is ours and temporary, whatever its reason (`CUSTOMER_ACCESS_CHECK_UNAVAILABLE`, `REDIS_NOT_AVAILABLE`, `REALTIME_HUB_NOT_AVAILABLE`): reconnect with backoff.

post.summary: Exchange the API key for a twelve-hour access token

401.description:
- `INVALID_CUSTOMER_KEY`: Unknown, revoked or missing API key. Do not retry with the same key.
- `EXPECTED_API_KEY`: An access token was sent here; this door takes the API key (`adk_...`).

403.description: - `CUSTOMER_TRIAL_EXPIRED`: The free trial has ended. Move to a paid plan; the same key works again.

422.description:
- `INVALID_END_USER_ID`: `end_user_id` is empty or longer than 128 characters.
- `INVALID_REQUEST`: The body did not parse, or two fields are wrong at once.

429.description: - `TOO_MANY_ATTEMPTS`: Over 300 token requests a minute for this account, or too many from one address. Wait for `Retry-After` seconds.

500.description: - `REDIS_NOT_AVAILABLE`: Ours, and temporary. Retry with backoff.

get.summary: Candle history, one page, oldest first
get.description:
Candle history for the symbols this account may carry.

Page backwards with `before`, which takes the previous response's
`next_before` verbatim. A null `next_before` means the horizon, not an
error: history is bounded by retention and by what the archive holds.

parameters.name: before

schema.description: Page backwards: return bars strictly older than this instant (RFC3339).
schema.title: Before

parameters.description: Page backwards: return bars strictly older than this instant (RFC3339).

401.description:
- `MISSING_BEARER_TOKEN`: No `Authorization: Bearer` header.
- `INVALID_ACCESS_TOKEN`: Not an access token.
- `INVALID_JWT`: The token is malformed or expired: request a new one at `POST /v1/tokens`.
- `EXPECTED_ACCESS_TOKEN`: The API key was sent here; exchange it at `POST /v1/tokens` first.
- `CUSTOMER_ACCESS_REVOKED`: Access was cut, or the key was rotated. A new token from the current key; if that is refused too, stop.
- `CUSTOMER_ID_REQUIRED`: A data token without its account claim.

403.description:
- `EXPECTED_DATA_TOKEN`: A token from another surface. Only tokens from `POST /v1/tokens` are accepted.
- `MARKET_DATA_SCOPE_REQUIRED`: The token's scope does not reach market data.
- `CUSTOMER_ID_REQUIRED`: A data token without its account claim.
- `CUSTOMER_KID_REQUIRED`: A data token without its key fingerprint.
- `TRADER_ROLE_REQUIRED`: Not a data token, and not a trader either.
- `MFA_REQUIRED`: Not a data token.
- `SYMBOL_NOT_ALLOWED`: This instrument is not in your account's list.
- `CUSTOMER_TRIAL_EXPIRED`: The free trial has ended. Move to a paid plan; the same key works again.

422.description:
- `TIMEFRAME_UNSUPPORTED`: Not one of S1, M1, M5, M15, H1, H4, D1.
- `INVALID_SYMBOL`: Shorter than two characters.
- `INVALID_LIMIT`: Outside 1 to 5000.
- `INVALID_BEFORE`: Not an RFC3339 instant. Pass `next_before` back verbatim.
- `INVALID_REQUEST`: Two parameters wrong at once, or one missing.

429.description:
- `CUSTOMER_MINUTE_CEILING`: Your plan's slices for this minute are spent. Wait for `Retry-After` seconds.
- `CUSTOMER_DAILY_CAP`: The daily runaway guard is reached. Waiting seconds does not help; it reopens the next UTC day.
- `TOO_MANY_ATTEMPTS`: Over 60 requests a minute for this end user. Wait for `Retry-After` seconds.

500.description:
- `SYMBOL_TRANSLATION_ERROR`: Ours. Retrying does not help; tell us.
- `REDIS_NOT_AVAILABLE`: Ours, and temporary. Retry with backoff.

503.description: - `CUSTOMER_ACCESS_CHECK_UNAVAILABLE`: Ours, and temporary: your token is probably fine. Retry after `Retry-After`.

post.summary: A single-use ticket to open the live stream
post.description:
Mint a single-use ticket for this end user's socket.

The ticket carries the customer and the key fingerprint forward, so the
connect guard re-checks both: a key revoked between the mint and the
connect does not get a socket, even though the ticket itself is valid.

- `INVALID_ACCESS_TOKEN`: Not an access token.
- `INVALID_JWT`: The token is malformed or expired: request a new one at `POST /v1/tokens`.
- `EXPECTED_ACCESS_TOKEN`: The API key was sent here; exchange it at `POST /v1/tokens` first.
- `CUSTOMER_ACCESS_REVOKED`: Access was cut, or the key was rotated. A new token from the current key; if that is refused too, stop.

- `MARKET_DATA_SCOPE_REQUIRED`: The token's scope does not reach market data.
- `CUSTOMER_ID_REQUIRED`: A data token without its account claim.
- `CUSTOMER_KID_REQUIRED`: A data token without its key fingerprint.

volume.title: Volume
volume.description: Tick volume: the number of price updates received in the bar, as a string. Not a traded volume: these markets have no central record of traded size. Some bars of the history come from another price feed and carry its tick volume, not counted the same way: the last day holding one, by the bar's open time in UTC, is `other_feed_until` per symbol and timeframe in `/symbols.json`, 2026-06-05 at the latest.

Candle.title: Candle
Candle.description:
One bar. Prices are STRINGS (NUMERIC(18,8) as text), never floats: convert
at the last moment, for display.

symbol.title: Symbol
symbol.description: The canonical symbol the page was read for.

timeframe.title: Timeframe
timeframe.description: One of S1, M1, M5, M15, H1, H4, D1.

candles.title: Candles
candles.description: Ascending by time. May be empty.

next_before.title: Next Before
next_before.description: Pass it back verbatim as `before` for the previous page. `null` means there is nothing older: stop. On S1 a page covers one day, so an empty page with a non-null cursor is an empty day (a weekend): continue.

CandlePage.title: CandlePage
CandlePage.description: A page of history, oldest first.

CodedError.title: CodedError
CodedError.description: A refusal: a code, which a 422 follows with a colon and the reason.

CodedValidationError.title: CodedValidationError
CodedValidationError.description: A 422: the code and reason, and the offending fields as data (possibly none).

FieldError.title: FieldError
FieldError.description: One offending field: where it is in the request, and why it was refused.

ticket.title: Ticket
ticket.description: Single use. Open `wss://<host>/v1/stream` offering two subprotocols, `adona.data.v1` and `ticket.<ticket>`; never put the ticket in the URL.

expires_in_seconds.title: Expires In Seconds
expires_in_seconds.description: Seconds before an unused ticket expires.
